run_f_gold: run f_gold to form the smallest number from a digit string using one swap operation
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple digit string inputs to verify correct one-swap minimization
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the rightMin array with a more memory-efficient approach
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that finds the optimal single digit swap to minimize a number string
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which swaps one pair of digits to produce the smallest possible number
